description: Men's footwear and accessory coordination rules for Urban Raja AI Stylist.

rules.name: Sneaker casual pairing
rules.guideline: Casual sneakers work best with casual and relaxed outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep sneaker shape consistent with the outfit's overall silhouette.

rules.name: Minimal sneaker versatility
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers can bridge casual and smart-casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use clean low-profile sneakers when the outfit needs a refined finish.

rules.name: Retro sneaker casual balance
rules.guideline: Retro sneakers add visual character and work naturally with relaxed casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat one sneaker accent color elsewhere when possible.

rules.name: Chunky sneaker volume
rules.guideline: Chunky sneakers visually increase the lower-body weight.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid pairing very slim trousers with extremely bulky sneakers unless intentionally styled.

rules.name: Slim sneaker proportion
rules.guideline: Slim sneakers work naturally with straight, tapered and tailored trousers.
rules.styling_tip: Use low-profile footwear when the outfit already has a clean silhouette.

rules.name: White sneaker neutral role
rules.guideline: White sneakers can act as a neutral visual connector.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat white subtly through another garment or accessory when useful.

rules.name: Black sneaker coordination
rules.guideline: Black sneakers visually connect easily with dark outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use black footwear to create a visually continuous lower half.

rules.name: Beige sneaker coordination
rules.guideline: Beige sneakers support earthy and neutral outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use beige footwear when white would create too much contrast.

rules.name: Grey sneaker coordination
rules.guideline: Grey sneakers work as a softer neutral than black.
rules.styling_tip: Use grey footwear to soften an otherwise high-contrast outfit.

rules.name: Navy sneaker coordination
rules.guideline: Navy sneakers pair naturally with blue and neutral clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the rest of the outfit relatively low in competing dark colors.

rules.name: Loafer smart-casual role
rules.guideline: Loafers elevate casual trousers and smart-casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Pair loafers with clean hems and avoid excessive fabric pooling.

rules.name: Penny loafer proportion
rules.guideline: Penny loafers suit refined everyday and smart-casual combinations.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the upper half polished enough to support the loafer's formality.

rules.name: Tassel loafer statement
rules.guideline: Tassel loafers introduce more decorative detail than plain loafers.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce unnecessary accessory density when the loafer is already detailed.

rules.name: Black loafer formal coordination
rules.guideline: Black loafers support formal and refined monochrome outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Match the belt family with the shoe when a belt is visible.

rules.name: Brown loafer earthy coordination
rules.guideline: Brown loafers work naturally with warm and earthy clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat brown subtly through the belt, watch strap or bag.

rules.name: Dark brown loafer versatility
rules.guideline: Dark brown loafers can bridge smart-casual and formal outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use dark brown when black feels too stark for the palette.

rules.name: Suede loafer texture
rules.guideline: Suede loafers introduce a softer and more relaxed texture.
rules.styling_tip: Use suede when the outfit should feel refined without appearing overly formal.

rules.name: Loafer trouser break
rules.guideline: Loafers generally look cleaner with little or moderate trouser break.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive stacking over structured loafers.

rules.name: Loafer sock visibility
rules.guideline: Visible socks change the formality and visual character of loafers.
rules.styling_tip: Choose sock visibility based on occasion and trouser length.

rules.name: Loafer with denim
rules.guideline: Loafers can elevate denim when the jeans have a clean silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid overly distressed jeans when aiming for polished styling.

rules.name: Boot casual pairing
rules.guideline: Boots add visual weight and structure to casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Balance heavier boots with sufficient lower-body volume.

rules.name: Chelsea boot refinement
rules.guideline: Chelsea boots work well with streamlined smart-casual silhouettes.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the trouser opening narrow enough to complement the boot shape.

rules.name: Chukka boot casual refinement
rules.guideline: Chukka boots provide a relaxed alternative to formal footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use suede chukkas for a softer casual appearance.

rules.name: Combat boot visual weight
rules.guideline: Combat boots create a strong rugged visual anchor.
rules.styling_tip: Use substantial garments to prevent the boots from overpowering the outfit.

rules.name: Chelsea boot trouser opening
rules.guideline: A controlled trouser opening keeps the Chelsea boot visible.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive fabric covering the ankle area.

rules.name: Boot and leather coordination
rules.guideline: Leather boots coordinate naturally with leather accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Similar leather tones create visual continuity.

rules.name: Boot color continuity
rules.guideline: Boot color can be repeated in small accessory details.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat the color without matching every leather item exactly.

rules.name: Boot with wide trousers
rules.guideline: Wide trousers can accommodate substantial boot shapes.
rules.styling_tip: Allow the trouser hem to interact naturally with the boot.

rules.name: Boot with slim jeans
rules.guideline: Slim jeans can work with streamlined boots.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid extremely bulky boots with very narrow jeans.

rules.name: Boot outfit seasonality
rules.guideline: Boots naturally support autumn and winter visual language.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate boot weight with the weight of outer layers.

rules.name: Sandal casual role
rules.guideline: Sandals work best in relaxed warm-weather outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the rest of the outfit casual enough to support sandals.

rules.name: Minimal sandal design
rules.guideline: Minimal sandals work well when the outfit already has visual detail.
rules.styling_tip: Use simple footwear to prevent visual overload.

rules.name: Slides casual boundary
rules.guideline: Slides are primarily relaxed footwear and should not be used for formal settings.
rules.styling_tip: Pair slides with intentionally relaxed garments.

rules.name: Sandal and trouser hem
rules.guideline: Relaxed trousers with sandals look cleaner when the hem does not excessively stack.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the ankle area visually intentional.

rules.name: Sandal and shorts proportion
rules.guideline: Sandals naturally support shorts outfits when the footwear remains visually light.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid footwear that is visually heavier than the shorts silhouette.

rules.name: Formal shoe role
rules.guideline: Formal shoes should support tailoring and formal garments.
rules.styling_tip: Keep formal footwear clean and well maintained.

rules.name: Oxford formal hierarchy
rules.guideline: Oxfords communicate a higher level of formality than most casual footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Keep accessories restrained when the shoe is highly formal.

rules.name: Derby versatility
rules.guideline: Derby shoes can transition between formal and smart-casual styling.
rules.styling_tip: Use Derby shoes when you need structure without maximum formality.

rules.name: Formal shoe trouser break
rules.guideline: Formal shoes generally benefit from controlled trouser break.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive stacking with structured formal shoes.

rules.name: Formal shoe maintenance
rules.guideline: Scuffed formal shoes can reduce the polished appearance of an otherwise refined outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Footwear condition should match the formality of the occasion.

rules.name: Shoe silhouette and trouser silhouette
rules.guideline: The footwear silhouette should visually support the trouser silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid extreme volume mismatch between trouser and footwear.

rules.name: Shoe visual weight
rules.guideline: Footwear with high visual weight anchors the lower body strongly.
rules.styling_tip: Balance heavy footwear with sufficient garment volume.

rules.name: Footwear color repetition
rules.guideline: Repeating a footwear color elsewhere can create outfit continuity.
rules.styling_tip: One subtle repetition is usually enough.

rules.name: Footwear contrast
rules.guideline: High-contrast footwear becomes a visual focal point.
rules.styling_tip: Use strong shoe contrast intentionally.

rules.name: Footwear neutralization
rules.guideline: Neutral footwear can reduce competition between colorful garments.
rules.styling_tip: Choose neutral shoes when the clothing already carries the statement.

rules.name: Shoe and belt relationship
rules.guideline: Visible leather belts should generally coordinate with leather footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Exact shade matching is less important than staying within the same color family.

rules.name: Shoe and watch strap
rules.guideline: Leather watch straps can echo leather footwear for a cohesive look.
rules.styling_tip: Use this connection mainly in polished outfits.

rules.name: Shoe and bag coordination
rules.guideline: Bag color can subtly connect with footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Do not force exact matching when the outfit already has strong color coordination.

rules.name: Sneaker and casual bag
rules.guideline: Casual sneakers pair naturally with casual bags.
rules.styling_tip: Match the bag's material and visual weight to the sneaker.

rules.name: Formal shoe and casual bag conflict
rules.guideline: Highly casual bags can weaken a formal footwear combination.
rules.styling_tip: Use structured bags when the footwear is formal.

rules.name: Accessory density
rules.guideline: Multiple accessories should not compete equally for attention.
rules.styling_tip: Choose one primary accessory and keep supporting pieces quieter.

rules.name: Minimal accessory foundation
rules.guideline: A watch and one subtle accessory can create a polished everyday foundation.
rules.styling_tip: Start minimal before adding more pieces.

rules.name: Statement accessory control
rules.guideline: A large statement accessory should be supported by simpler surrounding pieces.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid stacking several statement accessories together.

rules.name: Accessory scale
rules.guideline: Accessory size should relate to the outfit's overall visual scale.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid tiny accessories disappearing against very oversized clothing.

rules.name: Accessory material repetition
rules.guideline: Repeating materials can create subtle visual continuity.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat material rather than matching every accessory exactly.

rules.name: Watch casual styling
rules.guideline: Casual watches work well with everyday and relaxed outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use sporty or simple watches for casual outfits.

rules.name: Dress watch styling
rules.guideline: Slim dress watches complement formal and tailored outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the watch proportionally restrained.

rules.name: Metal watch versatility
rules.guideline: Metal bracelets can work across casual, smart-casual and formal looks.
rules.styling_tip: Keep other metal accessories within a compatible finish.

rules.name: Gold-tone watch balance
rules.guideline: Gold-tone watches introduce warmth and visual richness.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat warm metal subtly rather than adding many gold pieces.

rules.name: Black watch coordination
rules.guideline: Black watches work naturally with monochrome and dark casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use black accessories to strengthen a dark outfit's continuity.

rules.name: Watch case proportion
rules.guideline: Watch case size should remain visually balanced with the wearer's wrist and outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid an oversized watch becoming the only visible focal point.

rules.name: Watch strap material
rules.guideline: Strap material affects the perceived formality of the watch.
rules.styling_tip: Choose strap material according to outfit context.

rules.name: Watch and sleeve clearance
rules.guideline: The watch should remain comfortably visible without creating excessive sleeve bunching.
rules.styling_tip: Adjust sleeve length rather than forcing the watch into visibility.

rules.name: Watch with rolled sleeves
rules.guideline: Rolled sleeves naturally expose the watch and wrist.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the roll clean and consistent.

rules.name: Watch with blazer
rules.guideline: A refined watch can complement a blazer without overpowering the sleeve and cuff.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the watch relatively slim for tailored outfits.

rules.name: Chain with plain T-shirt
rules.guideline: A simple chain can add controlled detail to a plain T-shirt.
rules.styling_tip: Choose chain thickness according to the T-shirt's visual weight.

rules.name: Chain with graphic T-shirt
rules.guideline: Graphic T-shirts already carry visual detail, so jewelry should usually remain restrained.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid competing with a large chest graphic.

rules.name: Chain neckline clearance
rules.guideline: Chain length should interact intentionally with the neckline.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid placing the pendant directly over a busy graphic.

rules.name: Chain layering
rules.guideline: Layered chains should have visible separation in length and visual weight.
rules.styling_tip: Two coordinated chains are usually easier to control than many similar chains.

rules.name: Chain metal consistency
rules.guideline: Repeating the same metal family creates a cleaner accessory system.
rules.styling_tip: Mixed metals can work when intentionally designed.

rules.name: Silver jewelry with cool palette
rules.guideline: Silver jewelry naturally supports cool and neutral color palettes.
rules.styling_tip: Use silver when the outfit feels crisp and cool.

rules.name: Gold jewelry with warm palette
rules.guideline: Gold jewelry naturally supports warm and earthy palettes.
rules.styling_tip: Use gold as a warm accent rather than making every item gold.

rules.name: Chain with open shirt
rules.guideline: An open shirt creates visible space for a chain.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the chain centered within the shirt opening.

rules.name: Chain with turtleneck
rules.guideline: Longer chains can work over high-neck garments when intentionally styled.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid tiny chains disappearing against thick knitwear.

rules.name: Pendant scale
rules.guideline: Pendant size should remain proportional to neckline and garment scale.
recommendations: larger pendant for oversized casual looks
rules.styling_tip: Keep the pendant from competing with large graphics.

rules.name: Single ring minimalism
rules.guideline: One ring provides subtle hand-level detail without increasing accessory density significantly.
rules.styling_tip: Use one strong ring when the outfit is already detailed.

rules.name: Ring stacking control
rules.guideline: Multiple rings should vary slightly in size or position to avoid visual crowding.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid filling every finger with equally bold rings.

rules.name: Ring and chain metal
rules.guideline: Matching metal families can make jewelry appear intentionally coordinated.
rules.styling_tip: Consistency is especially useful in minimal outfits.

rules.name: Statement ring control
rules.guideline: A large statement ring should usually be supported by simpler jewelry.
rules.styling_tip: Let one hand-level piece carry the attention.

rules.name: Ring with casual outfit
rules.guideline: Rings can add personality to casual outfits without changing the base silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Use matte or simple finishes for understated casual styling.

rules.name: Bracelet with watch
rules.guideline: A bracelet can complement a watch when both have controlled visual weight.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid stacking several bulky pieces beside a large watch.

rules.name: Bracelet material repetition
rules.guideline: Bracelet material can repeat another accessory material.
rules.styling_tip: Keep repeated materials visually intentional.

rules.name: Bracelet with rolled sleeve
rules.guideline: Rolled sleeves create useful space for wrist accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Keep bracelet stacking controlled.

rules.name: Bracelet with formal outfit
rules.guideline: Formal outfits generally benefit from restrained wrist accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid visibly bulky casual bracelets with formal tailoring.

rules.name: Bracelet stacking limit
rules.guideline: Too many bracelets can create unnecessary visual density around the wrist.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce bracelet count when the watch is visually prominent.

rules.name: Black belt with black footwear
rules.guideline: Black leather belts naturally coordinate with black leather footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use this connection in formal and smart-casual outfits.

rules.name: Brown belt with brown footwear
rules.guideline: Brown belt and brown footwear create a traditional leather connection.
rules.styling_tip: Shade matching can be approximate within the same brown family.

rules.name: Belt width and formality
rules.guideline: Narrower belts generally suit refined outfits while wider belts suit casual styling.
rules.styling_tip: Match belt hardware scale to the outfit.

rules.name: Belt buckle scale
rules.guideline: Large buckles create more visual emphasis around the waist.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid a large buckle when the outfit needs a clean waistline.

rules.name: Belt with tucked shirt
rules.guideline: A tucked shirt exposes the belt as part of the outfit's visual structure.
rules.styling_tip: Use the belt to create a clean connection between shirt and trousers.

rules.name: Crossbody casual role
rules.guideline: Crossbody bags naturally support casual and streetwear outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Match bag size to the outfit's visual scale.

rules.name: Crossbody strap position
rules.guideline: Crossbody strap placement changes the visual direction of an outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Keep strap placement intentional and comfortable.

rules.name: Crossbody and oversized outfit
rules.guideline: A moderately sized crossbody can add structure to oversized clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid an extremely tiny bag disappearing against oversized garments.

rules.name: Structured bag formal role
rules.guideline: Structured bags support polished and professional outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use clean geometry when the clothing is tailored.

rules.name: Canvas tote casual role
rules.guideline: Canvas totes support casual, minimal and relaxed outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the tote's graphics controlled when the outfit is already patterned.

rules.name: Backpack casual utility
rules.guideline: Backpacks naturally communicate casual and functional styling.
rules.styling_tip: Match backpack volume to the outfit rather than choosing an oversized bag automatically.

rules.name: Bag color neutralization
rules.guideline: Neutral bags can support outfits with stronger clothing colors.
rules.styling_tip: Use neutral bags when the outfit already contains several colors.

rules.name: Bag material coordination
rules.guideline: Bag material should broadly match the outfit's formality.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid mixing extremely formal and sporty materials without intention.

rules.name: Bag visual weight
rules.guideline: Large bags increase the visual weight of the carrying side.
rules.styling_tip: Consider bag volume when styling oversized clothing.

rules.name: Bag hardware coordination
rules.guideline: Bag hardware can repeat the metal finish used in watches or jewelry.
rules.styling_tip: Use hardware repetition subtly.

rules.name: Baseball cap casual role
rules.guideline: Baseball caps work naturally with casual and streetwear outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep cap structure compatible with the outfit's casual level.

rules.name: Minimal cap styling
rules.guideline: A plain cap supports outfits without creating excessive visual competition.
rules.styling_tip: Use minimal branding when the outfit is already detailed.

rules.name: Cap color repetition
rules.guideline: Cap color can subtly repeat a garment or footwear color.
rules.styling_tip: One color connection is sufficient.

rules.name: Cap and formal outfit boundary
rules.guideline: Baseball caps reduce the perceived formality of traditional tailoring.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid caps when the dress code requires conventional formal styling.

rules.name: Cap and oversized silhouette
rules.guideline: Caps can complement relaxed and oversized proportions.
rules.styling_tip: Choose a cap with enough visual presence to remain balanced.

rules.name: Beanie winter role
rules.guideline: Beanies naturally support winter and cold-weather outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate beanie thickness with the weight of outerwear.

rules.name: Beanie color coordination
rules.guideline: Neutral beanies are easier to coordinate with layered winter outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat the beanie color subtly in another winter accessory when useful.

rules.name: Beanie and face framing
rules.guideline: Beanie height and fold can affect the visual framing of the head.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive fabric volume around the head.

rules.name: Bucket hat casual role
rules.guideline: Bucket hats strongly communicate relaxed and streetwear styling.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the rest of the outfit intentionally casual.

rules.name: Bucket hat pattern control
rules.guideline: A patterned bucket hat can become the outfit's focal accessory.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce other patterns when the hat is highly visible.

rules.name: Sunglasses casual coordination
rules.guideline: Sunglasses work naturally with casual, summer and travel outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Match frame visual weight to the overall outfit.

rules.name: Black sunglasses versatility
rules.guideline: Black frames work with most neutral and high-contrast outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use black frames when the outfit needs a strong neutral anchor.

rules.name: Brown sunglasses warm coordination
rules.guideline: Brown frames support warm and earthy color palettes.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat warm tones subtly through shoes or accessories.

rules.name: Metal frame refinement
rules.guideline: Metal frames can create a cleaner and more refined accessory impression.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate frame metal with visible jewelry when possible.

rules.name: Sunglasses and jewelry metal
rules.guideline: Frame hardware can coordinate with chain, ring or watch metal.
rules.styling_tip: Do not force matching if the frame has minimal hardware.

rules.name: Sunglasses outfit focal point
rules.guideline: Bold sunglasses can become a facial focal point.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce competing accessories when sunglasses are highly distinctive.

rules.name: Sunglasses frame color repetition
rules.guideline: Frame color can subtly repeat an outfit color.
rules.styling_tip: Keep repetition subtle rather than matching every element.

rules.name: Sunglasses with linen
rules.guideline: Lightweight sunglasses complement relaxed linen outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid overly aggressive sporty frames with refined linen styling.

rules.name: Sunglasses with streetwear
rules.guideline: Streetwear can support stronger and more geometric sunglasses.
rules.styling_tip: Keep frame volume balanced with oversized garments.

rules.name: Sunglasses and occasion
rules.guideline: Sunglasses should fit the practical and social context of the outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid treating sunglasses as a universal formal accessory.

rules.name: Visible sock coordination
rules.guideline: Visible socks should either blend with the outfit or provide intentional contrast.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid accidental color clashes.

rules.name: White socks casual role
rules.guideline: White socks can support sporty and casual sneaker outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the socks clean because their visibility makes them a focal detail.

rules.name: Black socks dark continuity
rules.guideline: Black socks can visually connect dark trousers and footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use black socks to minimize visual interruption.

rules.name: Dress sock coordination
rules.guideline: Dress socks should support the trouser and formal shoe combination.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid athletic socks with formal shoes.

rules.name: Contrast socks
rules.guideline: Contrast socks can intentionally add personality to a simple outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the rest of the outfit controlled when using statement socks.

rules.name: No-show socks with loafers
rules.guideline: No-show socks create an ankle-exposed appearance with loafers.
rules.styling_tip: Use only when appropriate for the outfit and climate.

rules.name: Socks with boots
rules.guideline: Boot outfits benefit from socks that provide sufficient coverage and comfort.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate sock color with trousers or boots for visual continuity.

rules.name: Socks with sandals
rules.guideline: Socks with sandals create a distinct casual or streetwear styling signal.
rules.styling_tip: Use this combination only when the styling direction supports it.

rules.name: Sock thickness and shoe fit
rules.guideline: Very thick socks can alter the fit of close-fitting shoes.
rules.styling_tip: Consider both comfort and silhouette.

rules.name: Sock pattern density
rules.guideline: Patterned socks add visual detail around the ankle.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce other small-scale patterns when socks are highly visible.

rules.name: Monochrome footwear
rules.guideline: Footwear within the same color family as the outfit reinforces monochrome styling.
rules.styling_tip: Use tonal differences to prevent the outfit from appearing flat.

rules.name: Tonal footwear
rules.guideline: Tonal footwear uses a nearby shade rather than exact color matching.
rules.styling_tip: Tonal styling often looks more natural than exact matching.

rules.name: Complementary shoe accent
rules.guideline: A complementary shoe color can create controlled contrast.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the remaining accessories restrained.

rules.name: Neutral footwear with bright clothing
rules.guideline: Neutral footwear can prevent bright garments from becoming visually overwhelming.
rules.styling_tip: Let the clothing carry the main color statement.

rules.name: Colored sneaker statement
rules.guideline: Colored sneakers can become the focal point of an otherwise neutral outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat a small amount of the sneaker color if needed.

rules.name: Black accessory foundation
rules.guideline: Black accessories provide a strong neutral foundation for men's outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use black accessories consistently in dark or high-contrast looks.

rules.name: Brown accessory foundation
rules.guideline: Brown accessories support warm, earthy and classic palettes.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat brown in two or three places rather than everywhere.

rules.name: Silver accessory system
rules.guideline: Silver accessories create a cool and clean visual system.
rules.styling_tip: Keep finishes reasonably compatible.

rules.name: Gold accessory system
rules.guideline: Gold accessories create a warm and richer visual system.
rules.styling_tip: Keep gold accents limited when the outfit is already visually strong.

rules.name: Mixed metal control
rules.guideline: Mixed metals can work when one finish remains dominant.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid equal amounts of competing metal finishes unless intentionally styled.

rules.name: Minimalist accessory balance
rules.guideline: Minimal outfits benefit from accessories that add detail without destroying simplicity.
rules.styling_tip: Leave enough visual negative space.

rules.name: Streetwear accessory balance
rules.guideline: Streetwear can support stronger accessories when garment volume is already relaxed.
rules.styling_tip: Keep one or two elements dominant rather than making everything oversized.

rules.name: Smart-casual accessory balance
rules.guideline: Smart-casual styling benefits from refined accessories with moderate visual weight.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid overly sporty accessories with polished garments.

rules.name: Formal accessory restraint
rules.guideline: Formal outfits generally require fewer and more refined accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive chains, bracelets and casual bags.

rules.name: Festive accessory richness
rules.guideline: Festive outfits can support more visible accessories than everyday outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate accessories with garment richness rather than adding them randomly.

rules.name: Wedding guest accessory control
rules.guideline: Wedding guest outfits can use refined accessories without competing with the main garment.
rules.styling_tip: Let the outfit's primary garment remain the focal point.

rules.name: Kurta footwear pairing
rules.guideline: Kurta outfits can transition between traditional and contemporary footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Choose footwear according to how traditional or modern the kurta styling is.

rules.name: Kurta accessory restraint
rules.guideline: Traditional outfits usually benefit from controlled accessory density.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid too many western accessories when the kurta is heavily detailed.

rules.name: Nehru jacket footwear
rules.guideline: Nehru jacket outfits can work with formal, traditional and refined casual footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use polished footwear when the jacket is structured.

rules.name: Sherwani footwear
rules.guideline: Sherwani styling generally works best with traditional or highly polished footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Keep footwear refined enough to support the garment's formality.

rules.name: Mojari traditional connection
rules.guideline: Mojaris strongly reinforce traditional Indian outfit language.
rules.styling_tip: Use traditional footwear when maintaining cultural continuity is important.

rules.name: Jutti casual traditional balance
rules.guideline: Juttis can support both festive and relaxed traditional outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate jutti color with the outfit without requiring exact matching.

rules.name: Kurta sneaker fusion
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers can modernize simple kurta outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the sneaker clean and low-profile.

rules.name: Kurta loafer fusion
rules.guideline: Loafers provide a refined modern bridge with contemporary kurta styling.
rules.styling_tip: Use loafers when the outfit leans modern rather than heavily traditional.

rules.name: Kurta sandal fusion
rules.guideline: Simple sandals work naturally with relaxed warm-weather kurta outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Choose clean minimal sandals rather than overly sporty styles.

rules.name: Office footwear
rules.guideline: Office footwear should align with the workplace dress code.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize polished and clean footwear.

rules.name: Date footwear
rules.guideline: Date outfits can use footwear that is polished while retaining personality.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid visibly worn footwear.

rules.name: Party footwear
rules.guideline: Party outfits can support more distinctive footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use footwear as a controlled statement rather than adding multiple loud accessories.

rules.name: Travel footwear
rules.guideline: Travel footwear should prioritize comfort while matching the outfit's casual direction.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid uncomfortable formal shoes for long walking days.

rules.name: Beach footwear
rules.guideline: Beach outfits naturally support sandals and slides.
rules.styling_tip: Keep footwear lightweight and practical.

rules.name: Gym footwear boundary
rules.guideline: Gym footwear should prioritize performance and stability rather than fashion alone.
rules.styling_tip: Do not treat lifestyle sneakers as substitutes for activity-specific footwear.

rules.name: Brunch footwear
rules.guideline: Brunch outfits can use relaxed refined footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Match footwear formality to the venue.

rules.styling_tip: Keep shorts structured and footwear clean.

rules.name: Boot with shorts
rules.guideline: Boots with shorts create a strong style statement and require deliberate proportion.
rules.styling_tip: Use only when the overall style direction supports the contrast.

rules.name: Sandal with shorts
rules.guideline: Sandals are a natural warm-weather pairing with shorts.
rules.styling_tip: Keep footwear minimal.

rules.name: Sneaker and sock height with shorts
rules.guideline: Sock height changes the visible ankle proportion in shorts outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Choose sock height according to the outfit's style direction.

rules.name: Shorts accessory density
rules.guideline: Shorts outfits benefit from controlled accessory density because more leg area is exposed.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid overloading both upper and lower accessory zones.

rules.name: Summer watch strap
rules.guideline: Lighter watch straps can support warm-weather styling.
rules.styling_tip: Match strap material to outfit casualness.

rules.name: Summer jewelry
rules.guideline: Warm-weather outfits can support visible jewelry because more skin and neckline may be exposed.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the metal system consistent.

rules.name: Summer bag
rules.guideline: Compact crossbody and canvas bags work naturally in summer casual outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Choose breathable and lightweight materials.

rules.name: Summer hat
rules.guideline: Caps and bucket hats can support practical and stylistic summer outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate hat style with the outfit's casual level.

rules.name: Travel sneaker practicality
rules.guideline: Travel sneakers should balance comfort, durability and outfit versatility.
rules.styling_tip: Choose a pair that works with multiple outfits.

rules.name: Travel loafer practicality
rules.guideline: Loafers can work for travel when walking demands are moderate.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize comfort over formal appearance during high-mobility travel.

rules.name: Travel boot practicality
rules.guideline: Boots can support travel outfits in colder or rugged environments.
rules.styling_tip: Choose footwear suitable for expected terrain.

rules.name: Travel crossbody
rules.guideline: Crossbody bags provide accessible storage for travel essentials.
rules.styling_tip: Keep bag size proportional to travel needs.

rules.name: Travel backpack
rules.guideline: Backpacks support longer travel while maintaining casual styling.
rules.styling_tip: Choose neutral colors for maximum outfit compatibility.

rules.name: Office sneaker boundary
rules.guideline: Sneakers are appropriate for office styling only when the dress code permits them.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid athletic-looking shoes in conservative offices.

rules.name: Office loafer preference
rules.guideline: Loafers can provide a polished office option without the rigidity of lace-up formal shoes.
rules.styling_tip: Maintain footwear cleanliness.

rules.name: Office boot selection
rules.guideline: Sleek boots can work in offices when the dress code permits them.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid rugged soles in conservative settings.

rules.name: Office watch
rules.guideline: A clean watch is a practical office accessory.
rules.styling_tip: Keep watch design refined.

rules.name: Office bag
rules.guideline: Structured bags support professional outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate bag formality with footwear and tailoring.

rules.name: Date night loafers
rules.guideline: Loafers can add refinement to evening date outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use a clean trouser hem.

rules.name: Date night boots
rules.guideline: Chelsea boots can provide a polished evening alternative.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate leather accessories.

rules.name: Date night sneaker
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers can work for casual date settings.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid heavily worn or athletic footwear.

rules.name: Date accessory restraint
rules.guideline: Date outfits benefit from intentional but not excessive accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the overall appearance effortless.

rules.name: Date sunglasses boundary
rules.guideline: Sunglasses are mainly useful for daytime outdoor dates.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid treating sunglasses as an evening accessory.

rules.name: Party statement sneaker
rules.guideline: Distinctive sneakers can become the focal point of a casual party outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Keep trousers and accessories relatively controlled.

rules.name: Party statement accessory
rules.guideline: One bold accessory can add personality to a party outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid making every accessory equally bold.

rules.name: Party footwear condition
rules.guideline: Party footwear should remain clean even when the style is intentionally casual.
rules.styling_tip: Condition affects perceived outfit quality.

rules.name: Club footwear practicality
rules.guideline: Club footwear should balance appearance with standing and movement comfort.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid footwear that becomes impractical during movement.

rules.name: Party bag practicality
rules.guideline: Compact bags are useful when carrying essentials during social events.
rules.styling_tip: Keep bag size visually proportional.

rules.name: Festival footwear practicality
rules.guideline: Festival footwear should account for walking, crowds and outdoor conditions.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize secure fit and practical sole grip.

rules.name: Festival accessory color
rules.guideline: Festival outfits can support stronger accessory colors than everyday outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Keep one main color accent.

rules.name: Festival jewelry layering
rules.guideline: Festive settings can support moderate jewelry layering.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate metal family.

rules.name: Festival traditional footwear
rules.guideline: Traditional footwear strengthens the cultural direction of festive outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate footwear with garment detailing.

rules.name: Festival modern footwear
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers or loafers can modernize simple festive outfits.
rules.styling_tip: Use modern footwear with simpler garments.

rules.name: Colorful sneaker with neutral outfit
rules.guideline: Colorful sneakers can act as the primary lower-body accent.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat only a small amount of the accent color.

rules.name: Colorful shoe with patterned outfit
rules.guideline: Patterned clothing and colorful shoes can create excessive competition.
rules.styling_tip: Choose one primary visual statement.

rules.name: Neutral shoe with patterned trousers
rules.guideline: Neutral footwear helps patterned trousers remain the focal point.
rules.styling_tip: Keep shoe details minimal.

rules.name: Statement shoe with plain trousers
rules.guideline: Plain trousers create space for distinctive footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Keep upper accessories controlled.

rules.name: Statement shoe focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: When footwear is the focal point, other lower-body details should remain quiet.
rules.styling_tip: Let the shoe carry the visual emphasis.

rules.name: Statement watch focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: A large watch can serve as the primary accessory.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid multiple large wrist pieces.

rules.name: Statement chain focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: A bold chain should remain the dominant neck accessory.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid additional large necklaces.

rules.name: Statement sunglasses focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: Bold sunglasses dominate the upper face area.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce competing head and neck details.

rules.name: Statement bag focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: A distinctive bag can become a strong torso-level focal point.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid multiple competing bags or large logos.

rules.name: Statement cap focal hierarchy
rules.guideline: A bold cap can become the primary head accessory.
rules.styling_tip: Keep other accessories quiet.

rules.name: Footwear and accessory hierarchy
rules.guideline: Footwear should support rather than compete with major accessories unless intentionally selected as the focal point.
rules.styling_tip: Choose one main visual anchor.

rules.name: Head-to-foot accessory balance
rules.guideline: Accessory emphasis should be distributed rather than concentrated only at the head or feet.
rules.styling_tip: Balance visual weight across the outfit.

rules.name: Upper accessory density
rules.guideline: Multiple neck, wrist and head accessories can create upper-body crowding.
rules.styling_tip: Keep the upper body visually breathable.

rules.name: Lower accessory density
rules.guideline: Large shoes, visible socks and belts can create strong lower-body detail.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid stacking several lower-body statements.

rules.name: Accessory distribution
rules.guideline: Accessories should create a balanced visual rhythm across head, torso, wrist and feet.
rules.styling_tip: Use distribution rather than maximum quantity.

rules.name: Footwear and body visual balance
rules.guideline: Footwear visual weight should complement the overall body and garment silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid extreme volume mismatch.

rules.name: Footwear and oversized top
rules.guideline: Oversized tops can support footwear with moderate or substantial visual weight.
rules.styling_tip: Keep bottom volume proportionally balanced.

rules.name: Footwear and fitted top
rules.guideline: More fitted tops can support streamlined or moderately substantial footwear depending on bottom silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Evaluate the full outfit rather than the top alone.

rules.name: Footwear and baggy jeans
rules.guideline: Baggy jeans generally work best with footwear that can visually hold the lower-body volume.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid extremely delicate footwear.

rules.name: Footwear and straight jeans
rules.guideline: Straight jeans provide broad footwear compatibility.
rules.styling_tip: Choose footwear based on occasion and formality.

rules.name: Minimal sneaker accessory system
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers work well with clean accessory systems.
rules.styling_tip: Maintain the clean visual language.

rules.name: Retro sneaker accessory system
rules.guideline: Retro sneakers can support slightly more playful accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat one sneaker accent color when possible.

rules.name: Boot accessory system
rules.guideline: Boots can support leather and metal accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Use accessories that reinforce the boot's style character.

rules.name: Loafer accessory system
rules.guideline: Loafers benefit from refined accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid overly sporty accessories.

rules.name: Sandal accessory system
rules.guideline: Sandals pair naturally with relaxed lightweight accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Keep materials appropriate for warm weather.

rules.name: Leather accessory family
rules.guideline: Leather accessories can create continuity across shoes, belt, watch and bag.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate leather family without demanding exact shades.

rules.name: Canvas accessory family
rules.guideline: Canvas accessories reinforce casual and utilitarian styling.
rules.styling_tip: Use canvas selectively.

rules.name: Metal accessory family
rules.guideline: Metal accessories can share finish for visual cohesion.
rules.styling_tip: Keep one metal finish dominant.

rules.name: Textile accessory family
rules.guideline: Textile accessories can create a softer casual appearance.
rules.styling_tip: Use textile accessories with casual garments.

rules.name: Technical accessory family
rules.guideline: Technical bags and sporty accessories reinforce functional streetwear.
rules.styling_tip: Keep technical materials consistent with the outfit direction.

rules.name: Footwear material and clothing material
rules.guideline: Footwear material should complement the perceived material formality of clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Use material harmony to support the outfit's formality.

rules.name: Suede and knitwear
rules.guideline: Suede footwear naturally complements the soft texture of knitwear.
rules.styling_tip: Use earthy tones for a softer winter palette.

rules.name: Leather and tailoring
rules.guideline: Smooth leather footwear supports structured tailoring.
rules.styling_tip: Match leather finish to outfit formality.

rules.name: Canvas and casual cotton
rules.guideline: Canvas footwear supports relaxed cotton clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Use simple designs for a clean casual look.

rules.name: Technical footwear and activewear
rules.guideline: Technical footwear naturally supports active and performance-inspired clothing.
rules.styling_tip: Do not use performance footwear as formal footwear.

rules.name: Accessory weather adaptation
rules.guideline: Accessories should adapt to weather and clothing layers.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize functional relevance.

rules.name: Rain accessory coordination
rules.guideline: Rain-ready accessories should maintain the outfit's practical style direction.
rules.styling_tip: Choose materials appropriate for wet conditions.

rules.name: Cold weather accessory layering
rules.guideline: Cold-weather accessories should support outerwear without excessive bulk.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate color and material across winter accessories.

rules.name: Hot weather accessory reduction
rules.guideline: Hot-weather outfits generally benefit from fewer and lighter accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Reduce unnecessary layers and bulky accessories.

rules.name: Seasonal material consistency
rules.guideline: Accessory materials should broadly support seasonal clothing materials.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid obvious material-season mismatches.

rules.name: Primary footwear selection
rules.guideline: Choose footwear based first on occasion, then outfit silhouette, then color.
rules.styling_tip: Do not choose footwear by color alone.

rules.name: Primary accessory selection
rules.guideline: Choose accessories based on outfit goal before adding decorative pieces.
rules.styling_tip: Start with one useful or defining accessory.

rules.name: Footwear recommendation priority
rules.guideline: When recommending footwear, prioritize suitability over trendiness.
rules.styling_tip: Trend should not override basic outfit compatibility.

rules.name: Accessory recommendation priority
rules.guideline: Accessory recommendations should preserve the outfit's existing visual hierarchy.
rules.styling_tip: Add only accessories that solve a styling need.

rules.name: Single accessory improvement
rules.guideline: When an outfit is already balanced, recommend only a small accessory adjustment.
rules.styling_tip: Do not change multiple successful elements unnecessarily.

rules.name: Footwear uncertainty handling
rules.guideline: If footwear type cannot be confidently identified, avoid making highly specific assumptions.
rules.styling_tip: State uncertainty before specific footwear recommendations.

rules.name: Accessory uncertainty handling
rules.guideline: If an accessory is partially hidden, distinguish visible evidence from assumptions.
rules.styling_tip: Do not invent unseen accessory details.

rules.name: Footwear color uncertainty
rules.guideline: Lighting can change perceived footwear color.
rules.styling_tip: Use neutral descriptions when color evidence is weak.

rules.name: Accessory color uncertainty
rules.guideline: Metal and leather colors can be distorted by lighting and reflections.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid claiming exact material when image evidence is unclear.

rules.name: Footwear visibility check
rules.guideline: Footwear recommendations should account for whether the shoe is fully visible.
rules.styling_tip: Do not infer exact shoe construction from a hidden area.

rules.name: Accessory visibility check
rules.guideline: Only visible accessories should be treated as confirmed outfit elements.
rules.styling_tip: Keep analysis evidence-based.

rules.name: Footwear replacement threshold
rules.guideline: Recommend changing footwear only when it materially conflicts with occasion, silhouette or style.
rules.styling_tip: Do not replace footwear unnecessarily.

rules.name: Accessory replacement threshold
rules.guideline: Recommend replacing an accessory only when it creates a clear coordination problem.
rules.styling_tip: Prefer adjustment over replacement when possible.

rules.name: Footwear alternative selection
rules.guideline: Alternative footwear should perform the same styling role as the original.
rules.styling_tip: Preserve the outfit's intended direction.

rules.name: Accessory alternative selection
rules.guideline: Accessory substitutions should preserve function and visual role.
rules.styling_tip: Do not substitute purely by color.

rules.name: Sneaker versus loafer
rules.guideline: Sneakers generally reduce formality while loafers generally increase refinement.
rules.styling_tip: Use occasion to decide between them.

rules.name: Loafer versus boot
rules.guideline: Loafers create a lighter refined lower-body impression while boots add structure and weight.
rules.styling_tip: Match footwear weight to garment weight.

rules.name: Sneaker versus sandal
rules.guideline: Sneakers provide more coverage and versatility while sandals create a warmer-weather signal.
rules.styling_tip: Consider weather and occasion.

rules.name: Boot versus formal shoe
rules.guideline: Boots generally add more visual weight while formal shoes create a cleaner formal line.
rules.styling_tip: Use the dress code as the deciding factor.

rules.name: Minimal sneaker versus chunky sneaker
rules.guideline: Minimal sneakers create a cleaner line while chunky sneakers increase lower-body visual weight.
rules.styling_tip: Match sneaker volume to trouser volume.

rules.name: Watch versus bracelet
rules.guideline: A watch adds function while a bracelet mainly adds decorative detail.
rules.styling_tip: A watch can be the primary wrist accessory.

rules.name: Chain versus pendant
rules.guideline: A plain chain creates subtler neck detail while a pendant creates stronger visual focus.
rules.styling_tip: Match pendant size to neckline.

rules.name: Cap versus bucket hat
rules.guideline: Caps provide a cleaner sporty signal while bucket hats create a stronger streetwear or relaxed signal.
rules.styling_tip: Choose based on the outfit's style language.

rules.name: Crossbody versus backpack
rules.guideline: Crossbody bags create a compact asymmetric look while backpacks distribute volume across both shoulders.
rules.styling_tip: Consider both function and silhouette.

rules.name: Leather bag versus canvas bag
rules.guideline: Leather bags communicate more refinement while canvas bags communicate more casual utility.
rules.styling_tip: Match bag material to outfit formality.

rules.name: Quiet luxury footwear
rules.guideline: Refined understated footwear supports a quiet luxury visual direction.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize clean construction and restrained branding.

rules.name: Streetwear footwear
rules.guideline: Streetwear footwear can emphasize volume, graphic details and casual construction.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate footwear volume with relaxed garments.

rules.name: Old-money accessory direction
rules.guideline: Classic leather and restrained metal accessories support traditional refined styling.
rules.styling_tip: Keep branding and hardware subtle.

rules.name: Minimalist accessory direction
rules.guideline: Minimalist styling benefits from fewer accessories with clean forms.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize negative space.

rules.name: Rugged accessory direction
rules.guideline: Rugged styling supports leather, metal and utility accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Repeat rugged materials without overloading the outfit.

rules.name: Preppy footwear direction
rules.guideline: Preppy styling commonly supports loafers, clean sneakers and refined casual shoes.
rules.styling_tip: Keep colors classic and accessories restrained.

rules.name: Resort footwear direction
rules.guideline: Resort styling supports loafers, sandals and lightweight sneakers.
rules.styling_tip: Use breathable materials and lighter colors.

rules.name: Utility footwear direction
rules.guideline: Utility styling benefits from substantial and functional footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate footwear with cargo and workwear elements.

rules.name: Smart casual footwear direction
rules.guideline: Smart-casual styling works well with loafers, clean sneakers and refined boots.
rules.styling_tip: Choose footwear based on desired formality.

rules.name: Casual footwear direction
rules.guideline: Casual outfits support sneakers, casual boots and sandals depending on weather.
rules.styling_tip: Prioritize comfort and silhouette.

rules.name: Formal footwear direction
rules.guideline: Formal styling benefits from polished structured footwear.
rules.styling_tip: Maintain clean lines and footwear condition.

rules.name: Minimal jewelry direction
rules.guideline: Minimal jewelry uses simple forms and limited quantity.
rules.styling_tip: Use one metal family when possible.

rules.name: Street jewelry direction
rules.guideline: Streetwear can support stronger chains, rings and bracelets.
rules.styling_tip: Keep one jewelry category dominant.

rules.name: Classic jewelry direction
rules.guideline: Classic outfits benefit from understated watches, rings and leather accessories.
rules.styling_tip: Prefer timeless shapes.

rules.name: Festive jewelry direction
rules.guideline: Festive styling can support richer jewelry while maintaining hierarchy.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate metal finish with garment detailing.

rules.name: Footwear condition check
rules.guideline: Footwear condition should be evaluated before recommending styling changes.
rules.styling_tip: Sometimes maintenance is more useful than replacement.

rules.name: Accessory condition check
rules.guideline: Visible scratches, stains or damage can affect accessory presentation.
rules.styling_tip: Do not confuse wear with poor styling when the style is intentional.

rules.name: Shoe pair consistency
rules.guideline: Both shoes should maintain consistent condition, shape and styling.
rules.styling_tip: Check both shoes before evaluating the footwear.

rules.name: Accessory pair consistency
rules.guideline: Paired accessories should remain visually consistent.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid accidental mismatch.

rules.name: Hardware condition
rules.guideline: Scratched or damaged hardware can reduce perceived refinement.
rules.styling_tip: Inspect highly visible hardware first.

rules.name: Footwear occasion check
rules.guideline: Before final footwear advice, confirm that the footwear suits the occasion.
rules.styling_tip: Occasion compatibility comes before color matching.

rules.name: Footwear proportion check
rules.guideline: Before final footwear advice, check shoe volume against trouser and outfit volume.
rules.styling_tip: Correct proportion before decorative details.

rules.name: Footwear color check
rules.guideline: After occasion and proportion, check footwear color relationship with the outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Use color to support the existing outfit rather than automatically changing it.

rules.name: Accessory density check
rules.guideline: Before adding accessories, evaluate existing accessory density.
rules.styling_tip: Add accessories only when they improve the outfit.

rules.name: Complete footwear accessory check
rules.guideline: Final styling should evaluate footwear, accessories, occasion, color, material and visual hierarchy together.
rules.styling_tip: Make the smallest useful change that improves overall coordination.
